literal_meaning: কলা পোড়া খাওয়া (eating burnt banana or banana residue)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুই কলাপোড়া খাওয়া যা, এত বাজে কথা বলিস না!
ওকে কলাপোড়া খাওয়া বলে তাড়িয়ে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Go eat banana shit, don't talk such nonsense!
He told him to eat banana shit and chased him away.
note: This idiom is highly vulgar and used in heated arguments; handle with cultural sensitivity.
